parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language in which you want to display the results. Valid values: zh and en. Default value: zh. The value zh indicates Chinese, and the value en indicates English.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse delete-namespace --biz-region cn-hangzhou --name prod --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse DeleteNamespace --region cn-hangzhou --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --AcceptLanguage zh --Name prod
